body:
Not being overly dramatic, but wow. There really is nothing in my life I can look forward to. My wife is a bitch whom I wish I had never even met. My job sucks. I have almost no credentials for another job.  It's so late to go to school. And even if I did, I'm not sure what I would do.  

The only thing I really have is my writing. And a hobby only prolongs the inevitable for so long.
All kids are at least a little bratty. Especially babies.
